description:
At `origin/main` `a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83`, the workspace has no `unreachable_pub` lint.

Reproducers:

```sh
cargo rustc -p fz --lib -- -D unreachable_pub
cargo rustc -p fz-runtime --lib -- -D unreachable_pub
```

Current results:

- `fz`: 297 diagnostics, including 147 functions/methods.
- `fz-runtime`: 17 diagnostics, all functions in private `runtime/src/heap/gc` (`forward.rs`: 12; `trace.rs`: 5).

Narrow every diagnosed item to rustc's narrowest correct visibility, then enable `unreachable_pub = "warn"` in the inherited workspace Rust lint contract. This is an all-item cleanup: restricting only functions would leave controlled warnings and make the ratchet unusable.

Preserve the six current crate-root exports unchanged:

- `pub mod compiler2`
- `pub mod ground_value`
- `pub mod types`
- `pub use function_surface::FunctionSurface`
- `pub use telemetry::causal`
- `pub use telemetry::sink::NullTelemetry`

## Acceptance

- Both reproducer commands succeed with zero `unreachable_pub` diagnostics.
- The workspace lint contract enables `unreachable_pub`.
- Normal workspace tests and lint gates pass without warnings.
- The six crate-root exports above remain exported.
- No runtime C-ABI/`no_mangle` export is narrowed.
title: Restrict 314 unreachable public items and ratchet workspace visibility
